snippet.title: Protect the Pit - Tower Defense where you Attack with your Cursor - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Attack with your cursor, build towers and walls to defend your pit! An incremental clicker that combines tower defense, maze building, and large upgrade trees. Earn money, upgrade your defenses, and build winding mazes to stop the hordes of the Dark Forest.

Play the demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4240850/Protect_the_Pit/
